text:
maria: Quick question — for the 'who changed what' surface we owe compliance: do we ship a downloadable bundle that contains full diffs + actor metadata, or do we offer a streaming NDJSON export + console timeline? Need input from infra and product. @aj @sam

aj: My vote is NDJSON streaming for large tenants. It avoids holding large bundles in memory and lets downstream SIEMs tail the stream. We can also provide a presigned URL for a generated zip for ad-hoc downloads.

sam: +1 for streaming, but two concerns: 1) query cost for generating diffs on the fly, 2) how we surface the "who" when actors are ephemeral (service principals, short-lived tokens).

kevin: For actor resolution we should store a compact actor-hint at write time (actor_id, actor_label, auth_type) so we don't do heavy joins at export time. That's already how rollout telemetry is stored. We can include actor_hint in each event.

nina: From a console UX POV customers want a timeline view "who changed X" with expand-to-diff and a download button per-change and per-range. Two modes: timeline-first (interactive) and export-first (bulk).

aj: API sketch:
```
GET /v1/tenant/{t}/audit/stream?since=1670000000&policy_id=abc&format=ndjson
Accept: application/x-ndjson

# server streams lines like: {"ts":..,"event_type":"policy.update","actor_hint":"deploy-bot","diff":"..."}
```

aj: For bundle downloads:
- kick off background job that writes gzipped ndjson + manifest + signatures -> presigned S3 link.
- Job should count against export quota.

sam: We need to define quotas and SLOs: exports are heavy IO. Proposal: free-tier tenants get 1 concurrent export, enterprise gets 5. Long-running exports (>6h) fail and give partial artifacts (cursor). Also: streaming endpoints should have throughput limits (tokens/sec) and backpressure.

kevin: About diffs: full diff vs compact patch. Full diffs are easier for auditors but huge. Recommend compact delta + optional fetch of full snapshot on demand. We can include snapshot_id references in the stream.

maria: Compliance also asked for justification fields (who said why) attached to policy changes. Should be included in exports. That could contain PII in free-form text — we need redaction options.

aj: Add query param redaction=none|pii-scrub|hash. Default pii-scrub for downloads older than retention_window. Also emit telemetry event export.started/export.completed/export.failed with export.size_bytes and export.duration_ms.

nina: UX note: when a download is ready, surface it next to the timeline range with TTL and "audit transcript" name used by customer. Also show quota usage and estimated cost before confirm. :money_with_wings:

sam: Security: presigned links TTL should be short (24h) and downloads should be signed server-side with an export_id so we can revoke links if needed. Add an "audit.export_revoked" event when admin revokes.

deploy-bot: deploy: export-worker v2 rolled to alpha; gzip+manifest path fixed.

kevin: Edgecase: tenant requests export for extremely high-change-rate resource. We should implement sampling + full-archive option. Sampling schema: 1) raw ndjson stream with sample_rate, 2) provide a manifest that maps sample ranges to full-archive job ids.

maria: Action items:
- aj: draft API spec and NDJSON shape (including actor_hint, snapshot_id, justification).
- kevin: proposal for actor-hint storage and snapshot references.
- sam: quota/SLO proposal + cost impact estimate.
- nina: mockup for timeline + download CTA and quota warning.
- infra: define export job throttles and revocation workflow.

maria: timeline: sync next Wed 10am to review RFC, pls drop initial PRs before EOD Tues. Thanks! :thumbsup:
